newsitem.title: INDIA: India's SRF completes CEAT unit purchase.
newsitem.headline: India's SRF completes CEAT unit purchase.

text.p: India's SRF Ltd said on Monday it had completed the 3.25 billion rupee purchase of Ceat Ltd's nylon tyre cord plant in the central state of Madhya Pradesh.
The purchase of Ceat's plant in Malanpur, announced in June 1995, doubled SRF's share of the Indian nylon tyre cord market to 40 percent, the company said in a statement.
When it announced the deal, SRF said it would finance the purchase by raising capital through equity, debentures and internal accruals.
SRF also has nylon tyre cord plants in the southern state of Tamil Nadu as well as in Dubai.
SRF said the Malanpur plant is running at full capacity, or 10,000 tonnes per year of nylon tyre cord.
The parent firm's operating profit has more than doubled since the acquisition and "the return on investment is good", the statement said without elaborating.
The Malanpur unit is the only plant in India manufacturing super-high tenacity nylon six yarn, it said.
Besides nylon tyre cord fabric, SRF makes belting fabrics, coated fabrics, fishnet twines, engineering plastics and flurocarbon refrigerator gases.
